CREATE TABLE technical_cases (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	company_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	passport_id VARCHAR(64), 
	job_id VARCHAR(64), 
	title VARCHAR(240) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	priority VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	resolution TEXT NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(passport_id) REFERENCES product_passports (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES jobs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE case_events (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	case_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	actor_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	note TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(case_id) REFERENCES technical_cases (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
CREATE TRIGGER case_events_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON case_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Case history is immutable'); END
CREATE TRIGGER case_events_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON case_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Case history is immutable'); END
